channel.title: Treasure Coast Today
channel.description: Local news for Martin, St. Lucie and Indian River counties, Florida.

item.title: Riviera Beach named only Florida city to win 2026 All-America City Award
item.description: Riviera Beach was named one of just 10 communities in the U.S. to receive the 2026 All-America City Award from the National Civic League, making it the only Florida city selected for the honor this year.

item.title: Juno Beach considers thousands in costs to replace fence at JB-7 beach access after resident complaints
item.description: Residents at the Colony Condos say people using the JB-7 public walkway are cutting through their private property since the town removed the old fence in 2023 for safety reasons.

item.description: The Martin County School Board filed a court challenge Thursday against an administrative law judge's recommendation to reinstate a teacher suspended last year .

item.title: S.D. Spady Elementary in Delray Beach jumps from C to A rating as Palm Beach County schools earn third consecutive A
item.description: The School District of Palm Beach County received an A rating from the state for the third year in a row, with S.D. Spady Elementary School making a dramatic leap from a C rating to an A.

item.title: Boca Raton High School band to represent Florida at National Independence Day Parade
item.description: The Boca Raton Community High School band earned a coveted spot in Washington D.C.'s National Independence Day Parade and will represent the entire state of Florida.

item.title: Breast cancer patient speaks out after Anthem denies coverage for reconstruction surgery hours before procedure
item.description: Beth Clark and her surgeon are speaking out after Anthem Blue Cross and Blue Shield denied coverage for a reconstruction procedure less than 24 hours before it was scheduled.

item.title: Fourth of July cookout costs rise 4 percent this year as inflation hits holiday staples
item.description: A Fourth of July meal for 10 now costs $73.82, up 4 percent from a year ago, according to the American Farm Bureau Federation's Summer Cookout Cost Survey.

item.title: Hobe Sound woman dies in home fire days before her birthday
item.description: Misty Dawn White, 46, was found dead Monday after a fire broke out inside her Hobe Sound home. Friends have launched a fundraiser to help her fiance rebuild after the flames destroyed many of their belongings.

item.title: Martin County School Board fights judge's order to reinstate teacher suspended over Charlie Kirk Facebook post
item.description: The Martin County School Board filed a court challenge Thursday against an administrative law judge's recommendation to reinstate a teacher suspended last year .

item.title: Juno Beach condo residents demand fence replacement at JB-7 beach access point as trespassing increases
item.description: Residents at the Colony Condos say people using the JB-7 public walkway are cutting through their private property since the town removed the old fence in 2023 for safety reasons. A fix could cost the town thousands of dollars.

item.title: Martin County maritime teams prepare for hundreds of Fourth of July boaters
item.description: Martin County Maritime Response Unit will have two boats with medics on standby in the north and south parts of the county as hundreds of boaters hit the waterways for the Fourth of July weekend.

item.title: Port St. Lucie approves land transfer for Florida Turnpike interchange at Midway Road
item.description: Last month, the Port St. Lucie City Council approved the first reading of an ordinance to give 7 acres of land to the Florida Department of Transportation to assist with a partial interchange on the Turnpike.

item.title: Autonomous transit company proposes elevated network linking West Palm Beach to airport
item.description: Glydways, a California-based autonomous transit company, will present a proposal to Palm Beach County commissioners Tuesday for an elevated network of self-driving vehicles connecting downtown West Palm Beach to President Donald J. Trump International Airport.

item.title: Port St. Lucie advances plan for Midway Road expansion and Florida Turnpike interchange
item.description: Port St. Lucie City Council approved giving 7 acres of land to the Florida Department of Transportation to assist with a partial interchange on Florida's Turnpike as part of the $95 million Midway Road Widening Project.

item.title: Stuart downtown dock to close Monday for $3 million renovation doubling slip capacity
item.description: Stuart's downtown public dock will close July 6 for a $3 million renovation that will nearly double its capacity from 18 to 44 slips for motorized and non-motor.

item.title: Hobe Sound community raises funds for man who lost fiance in deadly home fire
item.description: A Hobe Sound man is leaning on his community after losing his fiance, Misty Dawn White, 46, in a deadly home fire earlier this week. Preliminary findings from the sheriff's office point to an electrical issue as a possible cause.

item.title: Glydways proposes elevated autonomous transit linking West Palm Beach to airport
item.description: A California-based autonomous transit company is proposing an elevated network of self-driving vehicles that would connect downtown West Palm Beach to President Donald J. Trump International Airport, potentially cutting the trip to under 10 minutes.

item.title: Fourth of July cookout costs up 4% this year, reaching $73.82 for 10 people
item.description: A holiday cookout meal for 10 now costs $73.82, up 4% from a year ago, according to the American Farm Bureau Federation's Summer Cookout Cost Survey. Ground beef is up 5.5% and buns are up 7.7%.

item.title: Breast cancer patient speaks out after insurance denies reconstruction surgery hours before procedure
item.description: Beth Clark, 48, and her surgeon are speaking out after her insurance company, Anthem Blue Cross and Blue Shield, denied coverage for a reconstruction procedure less than 24 hours before it was scheduled.

item.title: Hobe Sound woman remembered by friends after dying in Monday home fire
item.description: Misty Dawn White, 46, died Monday in a Hobe Sound home fire that investigators believe may have been caused by an electrical issue. Friends have launched a fundraiser to help her fiance Mark rebuild.

item.description: The downtown Stuart public dock will close for a year of renovations funded by state grants, nearly doubling capacity from 18 to 44 slips for boaters.

item.description: The Martin County School Board filed a court document Thursday arguing that reinstating Spectrum Academy teacher Matt Theobald would be inappropriate after his Facebook comments about Charlie Kirk.

item.title: Lantana veteran gets lien removed and roof repaired after WPTV intervention
item.description: Stephen McCoy, a disabled and retired veteran in Lantana, had a nearly $7,000 lien lifted from his home and unfinished roof repairs completed after WPTV contacted the roofing contractor.

item.description: North Palm Beach residents and visitors will celebrate Independence Day with a full day of family-friendly activities, live entertainment and fireworks at North Palm Beach Country Club and The Clubhouse on July 4.

item.description: Multiple anonymous X accounts critical of Gov. Ron DeSantis were deactivated after prominent veterans of the Governor's communications team alleged they were tied to Second Lady Layla Collins.
